main.description: Assert an evidence-bearing, NON-ADJUDICATING fraud/scam signal into the kotoba Datom log (:adfraud.signal/*). CRITICAL (sukashi G4): this is a SIGNAL routed to an actor that ACTS, NEVER a verdict, finding, or accusation that an entity committed fraud (UPL / defamation boundary; sibling of danjo + akashi). sukashi only observes and does NOT adjudicate; every signal carries nonAdjudicating = true as structural proof. Fraud evidence routed to :akashi-malak is handed to akashi's com.etzhayyim.akashi.malakEvidenceCandidate bridge for malak handoff (G13) — sukashi never runs its own malak import or accusation. confidenceBp is a bounded estimate in BASIS POINTS (0..1000 = 0.0..1.0, integer implied units, mirrors kabuto's criticalityBp) to avoid floats, never a finding of guilt.

subject.description: :adfraud.signal/subject — the id this signal is ABOUT: an :adtech/id, :adcreative/id, :adauth.edge/id, or :addelivery.edge/id

confidenceBp.description: :adfraud.signal/confidence in BASIS POINTS of 1.0 (0..1000 = 0.0..1.0, integer implied units; mirrors kabuto criticalityBp to avoid floats); a bounded estimate, NEVER a finding of guilt (G4)

evidenceCid.description: :adfraud.signal/evidence-cid — KotobaCid of the evidence bundle (the ads.txt/sellers.json diff, the screenshot, the redirect trace). Encrypted envelope if it contains a person's likeness (G9)

routedTo.description: :adfraud.signal/routed-to — who ACTS on it (sukashi does not): :akashi-malak (akashi's malakEvidenceCandidate bridge, G13) | :kurashimori (consumer protection) | :tasuke (victim support) | :danjo (accountability)

nonAdjudicating.description: :adfraud.signal/non-adjudicating — MUST be true; structural proof sukashi states a signal, not a verdict (G4)

sourcing.description: sukashi-computed signals are :synthesized; a third-party-reported indicator is :representative (G5)
